# Captured ships arrive intact

Captured ships arrive as the player left them: the claiming marine doesn't damage the ship, which can be switched back to vanilla in the config file. SWI's bailing pilot already leaves the hull and equipment alone.

Source: [`tests/game/features/intact-captures.feature`](../../tests/game/features/intact-captures.feature)

| Unit tests | Game tests | Manual | Pending | By hand |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 2 | 1 | 0 | **1** |

## Scenarios

### The claiming marine leaves the ship intact

**Automated:** in game `claim_intact`

```gherkin
  Given "intact when marines claim" is on
  And an ownerless fighter at full hull
  And one of my M ships with marines, set to claim abandoned ships
  When the marine claims the fighter
  Then the fighter becomes mine
  And it keeps its full hull and all its equipment
```

### With the setting off, the claiming marine damages the ship as in vanilla

**Automated:** in game `claim_vanilla_when_off`

```gherkin
  Given "intact when marines claim" is off
  And an ownerless fighter at full hull
  And one of my M ships with marines, set to claim abandoned ships
  When the marine claims the fighter
  Then the fighter becomes mine
  And its hull drops to between 70% and 99%
```
